features: ✅ 60-Hour Playtime: The GOBOULT Z40 earbuds offer an impressive 60 hours of continuous playtime on a single charge, ensuring you can enjoy your music, podcasts, or calls for days without needing a recharge. Perfect for long journeys, workdays, or extended use.

✅ Zen ENC Mic for Clear Calls: Communicate with ease using the advanced Zen Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) mic. This technology reduces background noise, providing clear and crisp voice quality for calls and voice commands.

✅ Low Latency Gaming Mode: The Z40 earbuds feature a low latency mode, designed to minimize audio delay, enhancing your gaming experience with perfectly synchronized sound. Enjoy an immersive and competitive edge in your favorite games.

✅ Powerful 10mm Drivers: Experience deep, rich bass with the Z40’s 10mm drivers. Whether you enjoy bass-heavy tracks or dynamic soundscapes, these earbuds deliver a powerful and immersive audio experience.
✅ Type-C Fast Charging: Enjoy quick and efficient power-ups with Type-C fast charging. A brief charge provides hours of playback, making these earbuds ideal for those constantly on the move.

✅ Ergonomic and Comfortable Fit: Designed for long-term wear, the Z40 earbuds feature an ergonomic fit that stays secure during various activities, ensuring comfort even during extended listening sessions.

✅ Touch Controls: Manage your music, calls, and voice assistants effortlessly with intuitive touch controls. Easily adjust volume, skip tracks, or take calls with simple taps for a seamless experience.
✅ Sweat and Water Resistant: Built for an active lifestyle, the Z40 earbuds are sweat and water-resistant, making them durable enough for workouts, runs, and outdoor adventures.
✅ Proudly Made in India: Crafted with pride in India, the GOBOULT Z40 earbuds support local manufacturing while offering high-quality performance tailored to Indian users.
